## Summary

Describe the scientific, behavioral, or maintenance change.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] Documentation updated, if user-facing behavior changed

## Checklist

- [ ] The title uses Conventional Commits (for example, `fix: handle empty input`).
- [ ] Related issues, configuration changes, and FITS-output changes are linked or described.
